description:
Get the latest Fear and Greed index value.

    Sourced from the CNN Fear and Greed model, cached and refreshed periodically.
    Values range 0 (Extreme Fear) to 100 (Extreme Greed).

    Returns a dict with value (0-100), label (e.g. "fear"), and timestamp, plus
    `current` ({score, rating, updated_at}), `history`, and the per-component
    `sub_indicator_scores`.
name: get_fear_greed
